name: Analyzes Repository
description: A code scanning analysis was uploaded against this repository: a scanner ran here. This is the edge that separates 'scanned clean' from 'never scanned' — a repository with no ANALYZES_REPOSITORY edges has no code scanning history on the grid, whatever its alert count says. It is NOT the alert's placement (a finding is placed on the repository by CARRIES_COMPLIANCE_FINDING) and NOT the commit join (ANALYZES_COMMIT).
